The default units weft registers

Source: R/unit-defaults.R
unit_defaults.Rd

unit_defaults() returns weft's default table of units (rule 4.4.21), the rows of inst/weft-units.yml, in file order. It registers nothing: the table is registered the first time weft parses or converts a unit in a session, and again as each configuration is read (see u()).

Usage

unit_defaults()

Value

A data frame with one row per default unit and the columns unit, is ("base", or the definition as the table writes it), name, plural, symbol (character, NA where the row has none), space (logical, NA where the row does not say), before (logical, FALSE where the row does not say) and redefines (logical). The attribute file is the path of the YAML file.

Details

A row is written as a row of units: in _weft.yml is, and may be copied there. A row redefines (redefines is TRUE) when it has is and the units package already reads its unit, alone or as a prefix and another unit: pH as a picohenry, mph as a milliphot, gal as the galileo. Redefining rows apply under unit_defaults: weft (the default) and are skipped under si; the other rows apply in both.

Examples

unit_defaults()
#>          unit       is                         name         plural     symbol
#> 1          pH     base                           pH             pH       <NA>
#> 2         mph   1 mi/h                mile per hour           <NA>       <NA>
#> 3         nmi   1852 m                nautical mile           <NA>       <NA>
#> 4          Ma    1 Myr                million years  million years       <NA>
#> 5          ka    1 kyr               thousand years thousand years       <NA>
#> 6         gal 1 gallon                       gallon           <NA>       <NA>
#> 7         ppm     <NA>             part per million           <NA>       <NA>
#> 8         ppb     <NA>             part per billion           <NA>       <NA>
#> 9         NTU     base nephelometric turbidity unit           <NA>       <NA>
#> 10        PSU     base      practical salinity unit           <NA>       <NA>
#> 11        CFU     base          colony-forming unit           <NA>       <NA>
#> 12        MPN     base                         <NA>           <NA>       <NA>
#> 13 CFU/100 mL     <NA>                         <NA>           <NA> CFU/100 mL
#> 14 MPN/100 mL     <NA>                         <NA>           <NA> MPN/100 mL
#>    space before redefines
#> 1     NA   TRUE      TRUE
#> 2     NA  FALSE      TRUE
#> 3     NA  FALSE      TRUE
#> 4     NA  FALSE      TRUE
#> 5     NA  FALSE      TRUE
#> 6     NA  FALSE      TRUE
#> 7     NA  FALSE     FALSE
#> 8     NA  FALSE     FALSE
#> 9     NA  FALSE     FALSE
#> 10    NA  FALSE     FALSE
#> 11    NA  FALSE     FALSE
#> 12    NA  FALSE     FALSE
#> 13    NA  FALSE     FALSE
#> 14    NA  FALSE     FALSE
